what: Legacy-prefix self-heal validates repo-relative paths but not Bash-safe ALLOW entries
scenario_or_breakage: The fixer may insert a log-derived path with shell metacharacters into an unquoted Bash array. The next local verify runs the harness and can execute or misparse that entry.
suggested_fix: Reject paths outside a strict safe repo-path regex before editing ALLOW, or write properly shell-quoted array entries.

what: Known harness prepass is not required to apply both known fixes before verification
scenario_or_breakage: If one CI run contains both the legacy-prefix and cleanup partition failures, a short-circuit after the first fix leaves the second failure in place. Local verify then fails and rolls back the useful fix.
suggested_fix: Define _apply_known_harness_fix to run both narrow helpers, collect whether any changed files, and verify once after all matching known fixes are applied.
